title: Open Seminar; Contemporary Afro-Latin American Fiction
description: Explores Afro-Latin American fiction of the last 60 years. We will disc uss what techniques Afro-Latin American writers have experimented with as well as the themes they have delved into. We will be reading authors such as Zapata Olivella, Marta Rojas, Mayra Santos-Febres, Washington Cucurto, and Marcial Gala.
